reason: A browser-side UI skin plugin that registers preset and custom color themes, persists the selected skin, and exposes skin selection in Settings → General.

summaries.zh: 为界面提供预设和自定义配色皮肤，并在设置的常规区域中持久化和切换皮肤选择。
summaries.en: Provides preset and custom interface color skins with persistent selection and a skin picker in the General settings section.

capabilities: Registers preset and custom UI color themes
Persists skin and custom color preferences in the ui-skins settings namespace
Adds a skin selector to the Settings General section
Applies theme token overrides as inline CSS variables
